title: Galvanization
definition: Galvanization is the industrial metallurgical process of applying a protective zinc coating to iron or steel to prevent premature rusting and corrosion.
importanceInUpsc: Tested extensively in UPSC CSE Prelims (under Science and Tech: Materials Science, Chemistry of Corrosion, Sacrificial Protection) and Mains GS-3 (Infrastructure, Industrial Manufacturing, and Resource Efficiency).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and electrochemical mechanisms of Galvanization.
Evaluate industrial processes, spatial distribution, and policy dimensions of steel manufacturing.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions on corrosion prevention.
